summary: Rebuilds the plugin-installer and Plugin Manager images with credential-scoping fixes from ORAS 1.3.4 and the patched golang.org/x/crypto dependency floor required by the container vulnerability gate.
userImpact: The v0.20.0 plugin toolchain candidate no longer contains the critical golang.org/x/crypto finding reported in the embedded ORAS and Cosign binaries.
ORAS registry client certificates, custom headers, and debug traces receive the upstream 1.3.4 credential-scoping protections before the first public v0.20.0 toolchain release.

instructions: Use the v0.20.0 plugin installer 0.2.7 and Plugin Manager 0.1.7 images and their matching charts; do not deploy an earlier release-candidate image digest.

security: Updates embedded ORAS from 1.3.3 to the upstream 1.3.4 security release that scopes mTLS certificates and custom headers to the configured registry origin and redacts replayable credentials from debug traces.
Compiles both ORAS 1.3.4 and Cosign 3.1.3 with golang.org/x/crypto 0.55.0 so CVE-2026-56854 is absent from the shipped binaries.
Both production Dockerfiles verify the selected x/crypto module version from each compiled binary, and the HIGH/CRITICAL Trivy gate remains fail closed.
documentation: Plugin installer and Plugin Manager container notices record ORAS 1.3.4, Cosign 3.1.3, and the pinned x/crypto security floor.
rollback: Do not restore an earlier release-candidate plugin-installer or Plugin Manager image because it fails the current critical-vulnerability policy; roll back the complete v0.20.0 candidate instead.
validation: Plugin-toolchain release-policy and installer acquisition contract tests for both embedded binaries
Multi-architecture production plugin-installer and Plugin Manager image builds
Trivy HIGH/CRITICAL image scan confirming no findings remain in the embedded ORAS and Cosign binaries
